# Print Your Brackets

> > Printable tournament brackets and football office pools for sports competitions, including single and double elimination formats from 4 to 128 teams.

Print Your Brackets provides free downloadable PDF tournament brackets in various formats (single elimination, double elimination, seeded, blind draw) for organizing sports tournaments and competitions. The site also offers NFL and NCAA football office pools, power rankings games, and large-format poster brackets for display.

## Key Topics

- Single Elimination Brackets
- Double Elimination Brackets
- Seeded Tournament Brackets
- Blind Draw Brackets
- Printable PDF Brackets
- Large Format Poster Brackets (24x32)
- NFL Football Pools
- NCAA Football Pools
- Tournament Bracket Creator
- Fillable Brackets
- Power Rankings Pool
- Football Squares
- Super Bowl Pools
- Adobe Reader Compatible
- Excel Spreadsheet Brackets
